scope: Only authoritative-capture members of the Foundry Pass 1 input manifest.

authority_tier.meaning: The eCFR is maintained by the Office of the Federal Register and GPO as a continuously updated regulatory compilation, but it is not the official legal edition of the CFR.
authority_tier.permitted_claim: The captured bytes are authoritative source material for this experimental regulatory-reference pass at the declared point-in-time date.
prohibited_claims: that the eCFR is the official legal edition of the CFR
that source authority proves the compiler extracted or interpreted the text correctly
that the input list is complete without reconciliation against the withheld census oracle

reproduction_policy.eligibility_rule: A capture is eligible only when its input-manifest member records an approved reproduction decision, its classification is public-domain-us-government-work, and its decision payload digest matches the upstream source registry.
reproduction_policy.rights_boundary: Reproduction eligibility applies per listed capture and does not extend to unlisted documents, embedded third-party material, or an entire document class by implication.
reproduction_policy.factual_boundary: A reproduction decision establishes permission to distribute the covered capture; it does not establish factual accuracy, completeness, current applicability, or fitness for use.

required_before_parse: the path is a member of the closed input manifest
the byte length equals the member record
the sha256 equals the member record
integrity_policy.on_failure: Fail closed for the affected capture and emit no downstream candidate material from it.
